--Calendar

CREATE VIEW gold.calendar
AS
SELECT 
    * 
FROM OPENROWSET
    (
    BULK 'https://awprojectasr.dfs.core.windows.net/silver/AdventureWorks_Calendar/',
    FORMAT='PARQUET'
    ) as QUER1
